Stata log, count of "units not observed in base_period" warnings

scope_note: RT038 pins the one option combination on which fix_weights() was inert in the port: an unbalanced panel with method(reg), no covariates, no weights and the never-treated comparison group, where the cells took a four-means closed form that does not implement the base-period weight lookup. Every neighbouring combination -- any covariate, any weight, the not-yet-treated group, method(dr) or method(ipw) -- routes to the fitted path and already agreed, which is why no other fixture in the suite could see it. The warning count is a compared channel and not decoration: a run that skips the drop still returns a complete and plausible ATT(g,t) table, so the numbers alone do not reveal which sample was used.
